cohort: Mothers of full-term, low birth weight newborns admitted to a neonatal or postnatal unit at Liaquat University Hospital Hyderabad and Jamshoro between December 2020 and June 2021.
finding: Vitamin D deficiency was highly prevalent (87%) among mothers of low birth weight newborns.
mod_finding: Vitamin D deficiency was statistically significantly associated with mode of delivery (p=0.05).
